ja: もう一日あればいいのに。
en: I wish I had another day.
alternatives: I wish I had one more day.
If only I had another day.
point: 今の願望は wish + 過去形。had にする

ja: 移行は順調に進めてきました。
en: I've made good progress on the migration.
alternatives: I've made solid progress on the migration.
I've made a lot of headway on the migration.
point: progress は数えない名詞。a progress は不可

ja: 彼は我々の業務削減が必要と言った。
en: He said we needed to trim scope.
alternatives: He said we had to reduce the scope.
He said we needed to scale back the work.
point: trim scope は取り組む範囲を絞る。

ja: 私は今日、変更を戻すよ。
en: I'll roll back the changes today.
alternatives: I'll undo the changes today.
I'll revert the changes today.
point: roll back は変更を以前の状態に戻す。

ja: 今日はブロッカー一つある。
en: There's one blocker today.
alternatives: I've got one blocker today.
I have one blocker today.
point: 「〜がある」は There is + 単数

ja: 相談してたら我々は今迷わないのに。
en: Had we sought advice, we'd have clarity.
alternatives: If we'd sought advice, we'd have clarity now.
We'd have clarity had we sought advice.
point: clarity は曖昧さが消え、見通しがつくこと。

ja: PR はサムに見てもらう。
en: I'll have Sam review my PR.
alternatives: I'll get Sam to review my PR.
I'm having Sam review my PR.
point: have + 人 + 動詞の原形で「〜してもらう」

ja: 今日は、ほぼ会議で潰れました。
en: Meetings ate up most of my day.
alternatives: Most of my day went on meetings.
I lost most of the day to meetings.
point: meetings は複数で無冠詞。ate up で時間を奪う

ja: 私は仕様を確認しなきゃ。
en: I need to check specs.
alternatives: I have to verify the specifications.
I must check the specs.
point: check specs は仕様を確認する。specs は specifications の略。

ja: バグの原因、まだつかめてません。
en: I haven't found the cause yet.
alternatives: I still haven't found the cause.
I still haven't figured out the cause.
point: 否定の現在完了は yet を文末に置く

ja: バグを直してるよ。
en: I'm fixing a bug.
alternatives: I'm working on a bug.
I'm fixing a bug now.
point: 今していることは be + ing

ja: 私、ケンを手伝える。
en: I can help Ken.
alternatives: I can help Ken out.
I'm able to help Ken.
point: できるは can + 動詞の原形

ja: 背景を、少し教えてほしいです。
en: I could use a bit of context.
alternatives: I'd like a little context.
Could I get some context?
point: context は数えない名詞。a bit of / some を使う

ja: 私の作業は予想より厄介。
en: My task is trickier than expected.
alternatives: My task is harder than anticipated.
My task is tougher than expected.
point: trickier than expected は予想より扱いが難しい。

ja: 昨日テストを三つ足した。
en: I added three tests yesterday.
alternatives: I added three new tests yesterday.
Yesterday I added three tests.
point: yesterday があれば過去形

ja: 今日ケンはリモート。
en: Ken is remote today.
alternatives: Ken is working remotely today.
Ken is working from home.
point: 三人称単数は is

ja: 誰か、なぜ落ちるか分かる？
en: Does anyone know why it's crashing?
alternatives: Does anybody know why it keeps crashing?
Anyone know why it's failing?
point: 間接疑問は why + 主語 + 動詞

ja: QA のせいで足止めされてる。
en: We're being held up by QA.
alternatives: We're being held up because of QA.
QA is holding us up.
point: 進行中の受動は being + 過去分詞 held up

ja: あと一日あれば、テストも終わるのに。
en: If I had another day, I'd finish testing.
alternatives: If I had one more day, I'd wrap up testing.
I'd finish testing if I had another day.
point: 現在の非現実は if + 過去形、主節は would

ja: 詰まったら、聞くね。
en: I'll ask if I get stuck.
alternatives: If I get stuck, I'll ask.
I'll ask when I'm stuck.
point: if 節は未来でも現在形

ja: 今日ほしいのは、レビューだ。
en: What I need today is a review.
alternatives: A review is what I need today.
What I want today is a review.
point: What 節が主語。be 動詞の後に名詞が来る

ja: ログインのバグを直した。
en: I fixed a bug in login.
alternatives: I fixed a login bug.
I fixed a bug in the login.
point: 「〜の」は前置詞句で後ろから足す

ja: 私は文書整理に集中してる。
en: I'm focused on organizing documentation.
alternatives: I'm concentrating on organizing the documents.
My focus is organizing the documentation.
point: on の後の動作は organizing のように動名詞。

ja: 遅いけど、形になってきたよ。
en: Slow as it is, it's coming together.
alternatives: It's slow, but it's coming together.
Although it's slow going, it's coming together.
Slow though it is, it's taking shape.
point: 「形になる」は come together。Slow as it is で譲歩

ja: もう移行を終わらせました。
en: I've finished the migration.
alternatives: I've already finished the migration.
The migration's done.
point: 「もう」の完了は現在完了

ja: 知っていたら、手伝ったのに。
en: If I'd known, I'd have helped.
alternatives: If I had known, I would have helped.
Had I known, I'd have helped.
point: 過去の仮定は if + had 過去分詞、would have + 過去分詞

ja: 我々が必要と決めつける修正に疑問だ。
en: I question which fixes we assume are necessary.
alternatives: I question the fixes we assume are needed.
I'm questioning which fixes we believe are necessary.
point: which fixes we assume are necessary で我々が必要と思い込む修正を問う。

ja: いつ見てもらえる？
en: When can you review it?
alternatives: When could you review it?
When can you look at it?
point: 時は When で始める

ja: レビュー待ちで進めません。
en: Blocked on review, I can't proceed.
alternatives: Waiting on review, I can't move on.
I'm stuck waiting on a review.
point: 分詞構文で理由を前に出す。主語は後ろと同じ

ja: 今朝、私の PR がマージされた。
en: My PR was merged this morning.
alternatives: My PR got merged this morning.
My PR went in this morning.
point: された側が主役なら受動態 was merged

ja: 今日は在宅でもいいですか？
en: May I work from home today?
alternatives: Could I work from home today?
Can I work from home today?
point: May I 〜? は丁寧な許可。from home に冠詞はいらない

ja: あのバグ、引き続き調べます。
en: I'll keep looking into that bug.
alternatives: I'll continue looking into that bug.
I'll keep investigating that bug.
point: look into は「調べる」。keep + 動名詞

ja: 私は作業を終えなきゃ。
en: I must finish this.
alternatives: I have to finish the work.
I need to finish the task.
point: must で作業を終える必要を示す。

ja: 私はずっとレビュー待ち。
en: I've been waiting for a review.
alternatives: I've been waiting to be reviewed.
I've been waiting on a review.
point: have been waiting はレビューを待ち続けていることを表す。

ja: 私が嫌なのは対策に見せかけた忙しさだ。
en: What bothers me is busyness masquerading as mitigation.
alternatives: It's activity posing as mitigation that bothers me.
What troubles me is activity presented as a remedy.
point: masquerading as は実態と違うものに見せかける。

ja: ミアの PR を見てます。
en: I'm reviewing Mia's PR.
alternatives: I'm looking at Mia's PR.
I'm reviewing a PR from Mia.
point: 今の動作は be + ing

ja: 今、何の作業中？
en: What are you working on?
alternatives: What are you doing now?
What are you up to?
point: 「何の作業中？」は What are you working on? 前置詞 on は最後に残す

ja: 私がもっと早く共有すべきだった。
en: I should have flagged this sooner.
alternatives: I should've raised this earlier.
I should have shared this sooner.
point: should have + 過去分詞で過去の後悔

ja: 今日中に終わるかは微妙ですね。
en: I wouldn't bet on finishing today.
alternatives: I wouldn't count on finishing today.
It's touch and go whether I'll finish today.
point: 「微妙」は would を使い断定を避ける

ja: デプロイしなきゃ。
en: I have to deploy.
alternatives: I need to deploy.
I've got to deploy.
point: 「しなきゃ」は have to

ja: 私が休んでもいい？
en: May I take a break?
alternatives: Can I rest?
Is taking a break okay?
point: May I で休憩の許可を求める。

ja: 頼まれた修正が遅れた理由、話します。
en: I'll explain why the fix you requested slipped.
alternatives: Let me explain why the requested fix is late.
I'll explain why the fix you asked for is late.
point: why 節の中に、さらに関係節が入る形

ja: ケンに手伝ってほしい。
en: I want Ken to help.
alternatives: I'd like Ken to help.
I want Ken to help me.
point: want + 人 + to 動詞

ja: 詰まったら聞いてね。
en: Ask if you're stuck.
alternatives: Ask me if you're stuck.
If you're stuck, just ask.
point: 「〜したら」は if 節。命令文は動詞から始める

ja: 私が直した不具合が再発した。
en: The bug I fixed resurfaced.
alternatives: The bug I fixed returned.
The issue I fixed came back.
point: resurface は消えた問題が再び現れる。
